items.title: 14.11 Hawa ka mayar napne aur monitor karne ke tareeqe aur techniques (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.11, printed page 316.

blocks.text: Hawa ka mayar napna aur monitor karna particulate matter, nitrogen dioxide, sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide, ozone aur VOCs jaise pollutants ki concentration jaanchne ke tareeqon aur techniques ko milata hai; maholiyati engineers hawa ka mayar durust napne ke mukhtalif tareeqe istemal karte hain. Air Quality Index napne ka aala nephelometer hai, jo dhool, dhuan, dhund aur dhuen jaise PM ko monitor karta hai; photometer bhi kehlata hua, yeh zarraat ko un se bikharne wali roshni ki kul miqdar naap kar pehchanta hai.

blocks.prompt: Nephelometer kya napta hai, aur kis usool par?
blocks.explanation: Yeh particulate matter, dhool, dhuan, dhund aur dhuen ko hawa ke namoone se roshni guzar kar aur zarraat se bikhri kul roshni naap kar napta hai; zyada bikhrao ka matlab zyada particulate matter.

items: Monitoring PM, NO2, SO2, CO, O3 aur VOCs ko gherti hai; nephelometer (photometer) roshni ke bikhrao se PM napta hai.
